summary: You can ignite TNT in Adventure mode
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft 1.19.2 and create a new Creative world with default settings.
2. Obtain flint and steel.
3. Obtain TNT.
4. Place the TNT in the world.
5. Switch the player into Adventure mode.
6. Use the flint and steel on the placed TNT.
7. Observe that the TNT can be ignited in Adventure mode.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 1.16.5, 21w14a, 21w15a, 21w16a, 21w17a, 21w18a, 21w19a, 21w20a, 1.17 Pre-release 1, 1.17 Pre-release 3, 1.17 Pre-release 4, 1.17 Pre-release 5, 1.17 Release Candidate 1, 1.17 Release Candidate 2, 1.17, 1.17.1 Pre-release 1, 1.17.1 Pre-release 2, 1.17.1 Release Candidate 1, 1.17.1, 21w37a, 21w43a, 1.18, 1.18.1, 22w05a, 22w06a, 1.18.2, 1.19, 1.19.2, 22w43a, 1.19.3, 1.19.4, 1.20.1, 24w20a, 1.21, 1.21.3, 1.21.4, 1.21.7 (includes snapshots)
Observed Behavior:
In Adventure mode, a player can ignite a placed TNT block by using flint and steel on it. The TNT is removed and becomes primed, beginning its normal fuse and subsequently exploding. This occurs even when the player does not have the ability to build in Adventure mode.

The interaction is accepted based solely on the held item being flint and steel or a fire charge; the TNT interaction does not check the player’s `mayBuild` ability or otherwise restrict the action for Adventure mode.
Expected Behavior: In Adventure mode, attempting to ignite TNT with flint and steel should not activate it or cause an explosion. The TNT should remain in place and unchanged, since Adventure mode should prevent the player from igniting it, consistent with the inability to ignite candles or campfires without the necessary building permissions.
